affects: Emanuel Wilson; Zach Charbonnet; Jadarian Price
subject: Emanuel Wilson
headline: Emanuel Wilson plays only seven special-teams snaps as Charbonnet and Price return
body: Wilson played just seven snaps, all on special teams, in Monday's 34-17 loss to the Bears.
take: Thijs can drop Wilson. Charbonnet (6 carries) and Jadarian Price (10 carries) split the Seattle backfield, which keeps Dennis's Price a bench stash for now.

affects: Hunter Henry; DeMario Douglas; Drake Maye
subject: Hunter Henry
headline: Vrabel has no update on Hunter Henry's foot
body: Mike Vrabel said Monday that he had no update on Henry's foot and no expectations yet for Sunday's game against Green Bay, per MassLive.
take: Wesley should not count on Henry in Week 9.

affects: Carnell Tate
subject: Carnell Tate
headline: ESPN lists Carnell Tate out with a shoulder injury
body: Tate is listed as out with a shoulder injury, with an estimated return around Nov. 15. Tennessee is on a bye in Week 9.
take: Thijs loses nothing this week because of the bye, but Tate is not a Week 10 lock either.

affects: Emeka Egbuka; Kyle Monangai; Dontayvion Wicks; DeVonta Smith; Rashid Shaheed; Brian Robinson Jr.
subject: Emeka Egbuka
headline: New ESPN injury tags: Egbuka (foot), Monangai (thumb), Wicks, DeVonta Smith, Shaheed and Robinson Jr. questionable
body: ESPN updated several statuses on Tuesday: Emeka Egbuka (foot), Kyle Monangai (thumb), Dontayvion Wicks (ankle), DeVonta Smith (hamstring), Rashid Shaheed (knee) and Brian Robinson Jr. (hamstring) are listed questionable.
take: Carlier starts Egbuka in his RB/WR slot; Tampa Bay plays Monday night, so there is time to wait for practice reports. The others sit on benches or IR.

affects: Seahawks D/ST
subject: Leonard Williams
headline: Seahawks DT Leonard Williams exits with a stinger; OLB Connor O'Toole hurts his foot
body: Leonard Williams left late in the third quarter with a stinger and did not return; Mike Macdonald said they would see how it shakes out. Connor O'Toole came out with a foot injury, with no timeline given.
take: Seahawks D/ST could be short two front-seven players for Week 9 against Arizona; watch Wednesday's practice report before starting them.

affects: Caleb Williams; D'Andre Swift; Luther Burden III; Rome Odunze; Colston Loveland; Kyle Monangai; Jaxon Smith-Njigba; Cooper Kupp; Seahawks D/ST; Jason Myers; Zach Charbonnet; Jadarian Price
subject: Bears at Seahawks
headline: Bears rout Seahawks 34-17: Swift scores three times, Smith-Njigba 6-118-1
body: Caleb Williams went 24 of 34 for 247 yards and a touchdown, D'Andre Swift ran 27 times for 69 yards and three second-half touchdowns, and Luther Burden III scored on a 1-yard run. For Seattle, Sam Darnold was 17 of 34 for 188 yards, two touchdowns and an interception, Jaxon Smith-Njigba caught six passes for 118 yards and a 43-yard score, and Jason Myers missed an extra point and had a 33-yard field goal blocked. Seattle went 1 for 11 on third down.
take: Caleb Williams and Luther Burden III delivered solid days for Wesley, and Jaxon Smith-Njigba stays a locked-in WR1. Seahawks D/ST and Jason Myers were poor for Gevers and Thijs. D'Andre Swift's volume and touchdowns keep him a starter even with Kyle Monangai back later.

affects: Braelon Allen; Breece Hall; Omar Cooper Jr.
subject: Breece Hall
headline: Breece Hall (quad) reportedly good to go for Week 9 after missing five games
body: Forbes' Week 9 injury report says Hall, out five games with a quad injury, is now good to go and should play in Week 9.
take: Braelon Allen's 147-yard lead role is at risk once Hall returns; expect a split and treat Allen as a lower-end flex until the Jets show their plan. Matt can activate Breece Hall from IR.

affects: Tyler Loop
subject: Tyler Loop
headline: Ravens K Tyler Loop (groin) doubtful after missing Monday walkthrough
body: Loop was estimated as a non-participant in Monday's walkthrough with a right groin injury. Baltimore hosts Jacksonville on Thursday.
take: Darryl starts Loop and should line up another kicker before Thursday night.

affects: Bhayshul Tuten
subject: Bhayshul Tuten
headline: Bhayshul Tuten (ankle, foot) misses Monday walkthrough before Thursday game at Baltimore
body: Tuten was estimated as a non-participant at Monday's walkthrough with ankle and foot injuries. Jacksonville plays at Baltimore on Thursday night.
take: Eric-Jan starts Tuten and has to decide before Thursday night (Fri 2:15 AM Amsterdam). Watch the Tuesday and Wednesday reports; Chris Rodriguez Jr. would take most of the work if he sits.

affects: Jakobi Meyers
subject: Jakobi Meyers
headline: Jakobi Meyers (hamstring) questionable on a short week
body: Meyers had 2 catches for 24 yards on 3 targets in the 42-7 win over the Colts and is listed questionable with a hamstring issue before Thursday's game.
take: Darryl starts Meyers in his flex; with a Thursday game there is little time to swap, so check his status Wednesday.

affects: Matthew Stafford; Puka Nacua; Kyren Williams; Blake Corum; Rams D/ST
subject: Matthew Stafford
headline: Matthew Stafford dealing with right arm soreness
body: Stafford left the stadium after the 24-9 win over the Chargers with ice on his right arm, and Sean McVay confirmed Monday that he has some arm soreness.
take: Ylon starts Stafford against Washington; watch his practice reports. Nacua and Kyren Williams would take a hit if he misses time.

affects: Jaguars D/ST; Trevor Lawrence; Brenton Strange; Parker Washington; Cam Little; Derrick Henry; Mark Andrews; Zay Flowers; Tyler Loop
subject: Joe Fagnano
headline: Rapoport: Ravens sign Austin Reed to the practice squad to back up Joe Fagnano on Thursday night
body: Per NFL Network's Ian Rapoport, Baltimore signed QB Austin Reed to its practice squad as the likely backup to undrafted rookie Joe Fagnano, who is on track to start Thursday against Jacksonville with Lamar Jackson (thumb, IR) and Tyler Huntley (turf toe) hurt. The Ravens are also pursuing Bears backup Tyson Bagent in a trade.
take: Jaguars D/ST is a strong Thursday start against a rookie third-string QB, and the expected game script helps Trevor Lawrence, Parker Washington and Brenton Strange. Set Jacksonville players before Thursday's kickoff. Derrick Henry, Mark Andrews and Zay Flowers are downgrades.

affects: Jacoby Brissett; Trey McBride; Michael Wilson
subject: Jacoby Brissett
headline: Cardinals drop Jacoby Brissett to third-string QB for Sunday at Seattle
body: Mike LaFleur said Brissett is out of the starting role and will be the No. 3 quarterback in Sunday's game in Seattle, per The Arizona Republic.
take: Darryl has to bench Brissett, who was his starting QB. For McBride and Wilson, the Gardner Minshew-led offense is the new normal.

affects: Jeremiyah Love
subject: Jeremiyah Love
headline: LaFleur: Jeremiyah Love has a "new" ankle injury; update later in the week
body: Mike LaFleur said Monday that Love suffered a new ankle injury in the overtime win at Dallas and that he will give an update later this week, per ESPN's Josh Weinfuss.
take: André has Love on his bench. Tyler Allgeier took over the Arizona backfield, so Love is hard to trust in Week 9.

affects: Jadarian Price; Zach Charbonnet; Seahawks D/ST; Jason Myers
subject: Jadarian Price
headline: Seahawks activate Jadarian Price from injured reserve; he and Charbonnet combine for 16 carries for 52 yards
body: Seattle reinstated Price (chest) from injured reserve before Monday night's game against the Bears after a minimum four-game IR stint, and Zach Charbonnet made his 2026 debut. Per the team, the two backs combined for 16 carries for 52 yards in the 34-17 loss, and Mike Macdonald said the running backs came out OK.
take: Jadarian Price is no longer IR-eligible, so Dennis should move him from the IR slot to the bench before the next waiver run; ESPN blocks roster moves while an ineligible player sits in IR. Expect a committee with Charbonnet, so Price is a bench flex option for now.

affects: Cam Skattebo
subject: Cam Skattebo
headline: Harbaugh: Cam Skattebo (hamstring) is day-to-day and could be a game-time call
body: John Harbaugh said Skattebo is day-to-day and could be a game-time decision for Sunday's game at Philadelphia, per ESPN's Jordan Raanan.
take: Carlier starts Skattebo. A game-time call at 7:00 PM Amsterdam leaves time to swap in Alvin Kamara or Kimani Vidal if needed.

affects: Christian Watson; Jordan Love; Matthew Golden
subject: Christian Watson
headline: Christian Watson (ribs) is sore but "doing great," says Packers coach
body: Packers passing game coordinator Jason Vrable said Monday that Watson is sore but "doing great," per The Athletic.
take: André can expect to start Watson at New England if he practices this week.

affects: Josh Jacobs
subject: Josh Jacobs
headline: Packers "anticipate" Josh Jacobs remaining with the team
body: Matt LaFleur said Monday that the Packers are aware of the prior allegations involving Jacobs that recently surfaced and "anticipate him being a member" of the team moving forward, per USA Today.
take: Carlier can keep starting Jacobs for now, but an NFL review is still open.

affects: Jonathon Brooks; Chase Brown
subject: Jonathon Brooks
headline: Jonathon Brooks could be designated to return from IR this week
body: Dave Canales said Monday that Brooks (core surgery) will "potentially" be designated for return from injured reserve this week, per The Athletic.
take: Wesley keeps Brooks on IR for now; opening his practice window starts the clock on a return to the Panthers backfield.

affects: Jordyn Tyson; Travis Etienne Jr.; Chris Olave; Devaughn Vele
subject: Jordyn Tyson
headline: Saints to decide on Jordyn Tyson and Travis Etienne returns this week
body: Kellen Moore said the Saints will decide by Wednesday whether to open Tyson's 21-day practice window, and that Etienne (hamstring) would be evaluated before a decision on practice.
take: Carlier (Tyson) and Eric-Jan (Etienne) keep both on IR for now; a practice return this week points to Week 10 at the earliest for a full role.

affects: A.J. Brown; DeMario Douglas
subject: A.J. Brown
headline: A.J. Brown practice status uncertain: "We'll see," says Vrabel
body: Asked whether Brown (ankle, knee) might practice this week, Mike Vrabel answered "We'll see," per the Boston Herald.
take: Wesley keeps Brown on the bench until he practices; DeMario Douglas stays the top Patriots receiver while he is out.

affects: David Montgomery; Woody Marks
subject: David Montgomery
headline: No significant update on David Montgomery (groin) before Week 9
body: DeMeco Ryans said Monday he has "no significant update" on Montgomery before the Week 9 game against the Chargers, per the Houston Chronicle.
take: Connor has Montgomery on his bench; Woody Marks stays the Texans back to use until Montgomery practices.

affects: Michael Pittman Jr.
subject: Michael Pittman Jr.
headline: Michael Pittman Jr. (foot) is running again but has no timeline
body: Pittman said Monday he resumed running last week as part of his return program, but he has no clear timeline to come off injured reserve, per the Pittsburgh Post-Gazette.
take: Eric-Jan keeps Pittman on IR; Pittsburgh is on a bye in Week 9 anyway.

affects: Jonathan Taylor; Seth McGowan; J.K. Dobbins; Jonah Coleman
subject: Jonathan Taylor
headline: Schefter on Monday: a Taylor trade "is in play" until the deadline
body: On ESPN's Get Up, Adam Schefter said the Colts are open to dealing Jonathan Taylor, a lot of teams are interested, and "they don't want to just give him away." The deadline is Nov. 10.
take: Seth McGowan stays a worthwhile stash for Dennis: he becomes the Colts' lead back if Taylor moves. J.K. Dobbins and Jonah Coleman would lose work if Taylor lands in Denver.

affects: Saquon Barkley
subject: Saquon Barkley
headline: Barkley says the Eagles told him he is staying past the trade deadline
body: Barkley said after the 27-10 loss to Washington that the Eagles front office assured him he will remain with the team beyond the Nov. 10 deadline, per ESPN's Tim McManus.
take: Wesley's Barkley keeps his role in Philadelphia; his concern is form, not a trade.

affects: Derrick Henry; Zay Flowers; Mark Andrews; Tyler Loop; Lamar Jackson; Jaguars D/ST
subject: Tyson Bagent
headline: Ravens' top QB target is reportedly Bears backup Tyson Bagent
body: With Lamar Jackson headed to IR and Tyler Huntley awaiting an MRI on his toe, Jason La Canfora reported Baltimore's top pursuit is Tyson Bagent and that the Ravens have reached out to Chicago. Mike Florio said it "won't be cheap."
take: A competent QB would help Zay Flowers, Mark Andrews and Derrick Henry more than third-stringer Joe Fagnano. Until a deal happens, the Jaguars D/ST has a strong Thursday matchup.

affects: Trevor Lawrence; Parker Washington; Brenton Strange; Brian Thomas Jr.; Bhayshul Tuten; Jakobi Meyers; Jaguars D/ST; Cam Little; Derrick Henry; Mark Andrews; Zay Flowers; Tyler Loop; Lamar Jackson
subject: Tyler Huntley
headline: Huntley (turf toe) could miss Thursday vs. Jaguars; third-stringer Joey Fagnano likely to start
body: With Lamar Jackson headed to IR for thumb surgery, backup Tyler Huntley is almost certainly out for Thursday night against Jacksonville with a suspected turf toe, pending his MRI. Joey Fagnano went 10 of 21 for 91 yards and an interception in relief at Buffalo.
take: Jaguars D/ST becomes a strong start against a third-string QB, and the game script should favor Trevor Lawrence, Parker Washington and Brenton Strange. Remember the Jaguars play Thursday, so lineups lock early. Derrick Henry, Mark Andrews and Zay Flowers take a hit with Fagnano under center.

affects: Saquon Barkley; Dallas Goedert; Stefon Diggs; Jayden Daniels; Makai Lemon; Rachaad White; Commanders D/ST; Eagles D/ST; Jaydon Blue
subject: Saquon Barkley
headline: Commanders score 27 unanswered to beat Eagles 27-10; Barkley held to 30 rushing yards
body: Tanner McKee started for Philadelphia in place of Jalen Hurts. The Eagles led 10-0 early and did not score again, losing their sixth straight. Saquon Barkley ran 13 times for 30 yards and a 3-yard touchdown. Jayden Daniels went 16 of 29 for 217 yards and a touchdown, and Stefon Diggs caught 3 passes for 38 yards and the tying touchdown. The recap did not mention Dallas Goedert.
take: Saquon Barkley salvaged his day with a touchdown, but the Eagles offense is stalling under McKee, which caps Dallas Goedert and Makai Lemon. Commanders D/ST had a strong night, and Stefon Diggs scored again.

affects: Lamar Jackson; Derrick Henry; Zay Flowers; Mark Andrews
subject: Tyler Huntley
headline: Schefter: Tyler Huntley believed to have turf toe, MRI on Monday
body: Adam Schefter reports Huntley is believed to have suffered a turf toe injury and will undergo an MRI on Monday to determine how much time he could miss.
take: If Huntley misses time, Baltimore could be down to Joe Fagnano, which would further hurt Derrick Henry, Zay Flowers and Mark Andrews.

affects: Jonathan Taylor; Seth McGowan; J.K. Dobbins; Jonah Coleman; Josh Jacobs; Jordan Mason; Cam Skattebo; Chase Brown; Kenneth Walker III
subject: Jonathan Taylor
headline: Taylor market widens: Broncos in "hot pursuit", Chiefs and Bengals monitoring
body: A report says Denver is "going to try to pull this trade off" for Jonathan Taylor. Schefter and Rapoport reported Saturday that the Broncos, Packers, Vikings and Giants have interest; PFR adds the Chiefs (James Palmer) and Bengals (Jordan Schultz), and Schultz says a trade is "more likely than not." Indianapolis is seeking a package like the 2022 McCaffrey deal.
take: A Taylor trade would make Seth McGowan a starter and could cut into Jonah Coleman, J.K. Dobbins, Jordan Mason, Josh Jacobs, Cam Skattebo or Chase Brown depending on the buyer. Hold McGowan.

affects: Michael Wilson; Chad Ryland
subject: Michael Wilson
headline: Michael Wilson plays through two broken ribs for 8-111-1 at Dallas
body: Wilson caught eight passes for 111 yards and a touchdown despite two broken ribs. RotoWire called it a sell-high spot; Fantasy Six Pack rated him a buy.
take: Michael Wilson is producing through the rib injury and stays a WR2 start for Gevers, but keep an eye on the Cardinals injury report this week. Chad Ryland benefits from a functioning Arizona offense.

affects: Jonathan Taylor; Tyler Warren; Keenan Allen; Spencer Shrader; Seth McGowan; Josh Downs
subject: Anthony Richardson
headline: Colts pull Daniel Jones for Anthony Richardson; Steichen will not commit to a starter
body: Daniel Jones went 19 of 28 for 144 yards, a touchdown and two interceptions before Anthony Richardson replaced him in the 42-7 loss. Jonathan Taylor had 8 carries for 23 yards and 4 catches for 24 yards and fumbled on a trick play. Roto Street Journal notes Steichen would not commit to Jones and Richardson could become the full-time starter.
take: A possible QB change adds uncertainty for Tyler Warren, Keenan Allen and Josh Downs. Jonathan Taylor's ugly day comes amid heavy trade talk, which keeps Seth McGowan a priority stash.

affects: J.K. Dobbins; Jonah Coleman; Broncos D/ST
subject: Jonah Coleman
headline: Jonah Coleman takes over Denver backfield in second half with a 90% snap rate
body: Roto Street Journal reports Coleman was the only Broncos running back to touch the ball in the second half, with a 90% snap rate and over 20 fantasy points on 15 touches, as Denver beat Kansas City.
take: Jonah Coleman looks like the lead back now and is a strong start. J.K. Dobbins drops to a bench option until his role is clearer.

affects: Lamar Jackson; Derrick Henry; Mark Andrews; Zay Flowers; Tyler Loop; Jaguars D/ST; Trevor Lawrence
subject: Lamar Jackson
headline: Lamar Jackson headed to IR for thumb surgery; backup Tyler Huntley hurt his toe at Buffalo
body: Coach Jesse Minter said Jackson will be placed on injured reserve and have surgery on his right thumb, keeping him out at least four weeks. Huntley suffered what is thought to be turf toe in the first half and did not return; Joe Fagnano went 10 of 21 for 91 yards and an interception.
take: Lamar Jackson managers need a replacement QB for at least four weeks. Derrick Henry, Mark Andrews and Zay Flowers lose efficiency with a backup under center. Jaguars D/ST gets an appealing Week 9 matchup at Baltimore on Thursday night.

affects: Ashton Jeanty; Brock Bowers; Tre Tucker; Geno Smith; Garrett Wilson; Omar Cooper Jr.
subject: Mike Washington Jr.
headline: Mike Washington Jr. gets 25 carries; Jeanty says he was told Washington is the starter
body: SI's Michael Fabiano calls Washington a must-add after he carried 25 times in the 38-33 win over the Jets, noting Ashton Jeanty said he was told Washington is the starter. On the Jets side, Adonai Mitchell caught 7 passes for 142 yards and a touchdown.
take: Bad news for Ashton Jeanty managers: his role may shrink to a backup or split. Adding Mike Washington Jr. is the hedge. Omar Cooper Jr. and Garrett Wilson now share targets with a hot Adonai Mitchell.

affects: Dylan Sampson; Quinshon Judkins; Germie Bernard; DK Metcalf; Jaylen Warren; Rico Dowdle; Steelers D/ST; Chris Boswell
subject: Dylan Sampson
headline: Steelers beat Browns 27-6; Dylan Sampson catches six passes in a split with Judkins
body: Pittsburgh won 27-6. DraftKings Network lists Dylan Sampson with six catches for 62 yards and calls him a strong PPR option in a timeshare with Quinshon Judkins.
take: Dylan Sampson is a PPR flex option and Quinshon Judkins's ceiling is capped by the split. Steelers D/ST held Cleveland to six points.

affects: Caleb Douglas; Malik Washington; Ollie Gordon II
subject: Caleb Douglas
headline: Caleb Douglas limps off with a foot or ankle injury against the Patriots
body: Douglas was rolled up on during a tackle in the fourth quarter and limped to the bench after 3 catches for 31 yards. Heavy's writer thinks the ankle is more likely than the foot. No return status was given.
take: Caleb Douglas is a bench piece; watch Wednesday's practice report before relying on him. Malik Washington would gain targets if Douglas misses time.

affects: Jeremiyah Love; Trey McBride; Michael Wilson; Jacoby Brissett; Chad Ryland
subject: Jeremiyah Love
headline: Jeremiyah Love re-injures ankle after nine carries; Allgeier racks up 191 yards
body: Love left at Dallas with another ankle injury after nine carries for 23 yards and is day-to-day. Bam Knight left with a concussion, and Tyler Allgeier took over with 16 touches for 191 yards and two touchdowns.
take: Jeremiyah Love is a hold-and-wait on André's bench; Tyler Allgeier is the waiver priority if Love misses time. Chad Ryland keeps a productive offense either way.

affects: DJ Moore; Josh Allen; James Cook III; Tyler Bass
subject: DJ Moore
headline: DJ Moore returns from a two-game absence with 4-82-1 against Baltimore
body: Moore caught four passes for 82 yards and a touchdown in his first game back, looking like the same player, per RotoWire.
take: DJ Moore is back in Darryl's starting lineup without concern. Josh Allen gets his top target back, which helps Gevers, and James Cook III keeps the rushing role in a strong offense.

affects: Hunter Henry
subject: Hunter Henry
headline: Hunter Henry hurts his foot at Miami and is ruled out for the rest of the game
body: Henry left the Week 8 win in Miami with a foot injury and did not return. His quarterback said he was worried about him; no timeline yet.
take: Hunter Henry is a Week 9 question mark for Wesley. Watch Wednesday's practice report; Eli Raridon is the short-term replacement if Henry sits.

affects: Saquon Barkley
subject: Saquon Barkley
headline: Barkley played through hamstring and back issues; Elijah Mitchell got 15 touches
body: Barkley scored a 3-yard touchdown in the 27-10 loss to Washington but managed hamstring and back issues during the game while Elijah Mitchell rotated in for 15 touches.
take: Saquon Barkley stays Wesley's RB1, but the split with Mitchell lowers his floor until he is fully healthy. Elijah Mitchell is the handcuff to hold.

affects: Chad Ryland; Michael Wilson; Trey McBride
subject: Chad Ryland
headline: Ryland walks off Cowboys with 42-yard OT field goal; Wilson scores tying TD; Love ankle "didn't look good"
body: Arizona won 33-30 in overtime. Ryland missed a potential go-ahead extra point in the fourth quarter but hit the 42-yard winner. Michael Wilson caught the tying touchdown with six seconds left and a key 17-yard third-down catch in overtime while playing through rib pain. Jeremiyah Love left with another ankle injury and Bam Knight was ruled out after a hit; Tyler Allgeier ran 11 times for 147 yards and a 63-yard touchdown.
take: Chad Ryland scored the winner despite a missed extra point. Michael Wilson stays a WR2/3 but is playing through rib pain. With Love's ankle in doubt, Tyler Allgeier is the waiver add.

affects: DJ Moore; Josh Allen
subject: DJ Moore
headline: DJ Moore says he is okay after a late knee exit against Baltimore
body: Moore indicated after the 36-10 win over the Ravens that he is fine after leaving late with a knee issue, per NFL Network's Cameron Wolfe.
take: Darryl can plan to start Moore at Minnesota on Monday night, pending the practice reports.

affects: Omar Cooper Jr.; Garrett Wilson; Geno Smith
subject: Adonai Mitchell
headline: Adonai Mitchell explodes for 7-142-1 against the Raiders
body: Mitchell caught 7 passes for 142 yards and a touchdown in Week 8 and was the overall WR1 for the week. Yahoo calls him a volatile WR3 or flex with a high ceiling, with Kansas City next.
take: Omar Cooper Jr. now has another target competitor in New York. Keep starting Garrett Wilson, but Omar Cooper Jr. is more of a flex until the pecking order settles.

affects: Jadarian Price; Zach Charbonnet; Jaxon Smith-Njigba; Cooper Kupp; Seahawks D/ST; Jason Myers; Caleb Williams; Luther Burden III; Rome Odunze; D'Andre Swift; Colston Loveland; Kyle Monangai
subject: Zach Charbonnet
headline: Monday night: Charbonnet cleared, Price may be ready; Cross and Shaheed out; Bears without Monangai and Kmet
body: Seattle ruled out LT Charles Cross (ankle) and WR Rashid Shaheed (knee); Josh Jones starts at left tackle and Tory Horton gets a bigger role. Zach Charbonnet was cleared to play and Jadarian Price practiced with no designation. Chicago is without Kyle Monangai (thumb, toe) and TE Cole Kmet, who suffered a season-ending knee injury. Seattle is a 3-point favorite.
take: Seattle's backfield could be a three-way split with Charbonnet and Price back, so Jadarian Price is a risky start. Jaxon Smith-Njigba and Cooper Kupp get more targets without Shaheed. Colston Loveland gains with Kmet out, and D'Andre Swift keeps the lead role.

affects: Jacoby Brissett; Chad Ryland; Michael Wilson; Trey McBride
subject: Jacoby Brissett
headline: Jacoby Brissett benched for Gardner Minshew down 17-3 at Dallas
body: Brissett completed 10 of 23 passes for 119 yards and an interception and was sacked four times before being benched in the third quarter. Minshew threw three touchdowns for 188 yards in the comeback win.
take: Jacoby Brissett may have lost the starting job; his managers should line up another QB for Week 9 at Seattle. Michael Wilson, Trey McBride and Chad Ryland looked fine with Minshew in the second half.

affects: Brian Thomas Jr.; Parker Washington; Trevor Lawrence; Brenton Strange; Josh Downs; Keenan Allen
subject: Brian Thomas Jr.
headline: Schefter: Jaguars "warming to the idea" of trading Brian Thomas Jr.; Colts want a third for Downs
body: On Sunday NFL Countdown, Schefter said wide receiver is the position to watch at the deadline: the Jaguars are warming to trading Thomas, the Colts want a third-round pick for Josh Downs, the Browns are open on Jerry Jeudy, and Calvin Ridley and Hollywood Brown could be had.
take: A Brian Thomas Jr. trade would open more targets for Parker Washington and Brenton Strange in Jacksonville. A Josh Downs deal would help Keenan Allen.

affects: Braelon Allen; Breece Hall
subject: Braelon Allen
headline: Braelon Allen runs for a career-high 147 yards and a touchdown in loss to Raiders
body: Allen carried 21 times for 147 yards and a 21-yard third-quarter touchdown and caught 2 passes for 6 yards in the 38-33 loss to Las Vegas. It was his fifth straight start with Breece Hall (quadriceps) out and his fourth straight game over 100 scrimmage yards.
take: Braelon Allen keeps producing as the lead back. If Breece Hall returns for Week 9 against Kansas City, RotoWire expects a split, which would cap Allen and give Breece Hall managers a usable back again.

affects: Tee Higgins; Ja'Marr Chase; Joe Burrow; Chase Brown; Evan McPherson; Bengals D/ST
subject: Tee Higgins
headline: Tee Higgins catches 10 of 11 targets for 155 yards and two touchdowns in 43-36 overtime win
body: Higgins scored from 17 and 18 yards in the second half, the second tying the game late in regulation, as Joe Burrow threw for 462 yards and five touchdowns against the Titans. Higgins has at least 148 receiving yards in three of his last four games.
take: Tee Higgins is playing as a 1-A receiver next to Ja'Marr Chase and is a firm WR2 for Week 9 against Atlanta in Madrid. Joe Burrow and Ja'Marr Chase benefit from the same shootout, while Bengals D/ST gave up 36 points.

affects: James Cook III; Josh Allen; Tyler Bass
subject: James Cook III
headline: James Cook scores again in 36-10 rout of Ravens; cleared after late head-injury check
body: Cook ran 21 times for 80 yards and a 5-yard touchdown and caught 2 of 3 targets for 21 yards. He was evaluated for a head injury late in the game, was cleared to return and got one more carry. He has at least 75 rushing yards and a touchdown in six straight games.
take: James Cook III was cleared during the game, so there is no injury concern for now. He faces Minnesota's strong defense on Monday night in Week 9; keep him in the lineup.

affects: Trevor Lawrence; Parker Washington; Bhayshul Tuten; Brenton Strange; Brian Thomas Jr.; Jaguars D/ST; Cam Little; Jakobi Meyers
subject: Trevor Lawrence
headline: Jaguars rout Colts 42-7: Lawrence 10-of-14 for 210 yards and 3 TDs; Tuten scores twice
body: Lawrence threw three touchdowns on 14 attempts and sat for most of the fourth quarter. Bhayshul Tuten ran 16 times for 104 yards and a score and added a receiving touchdown. Jacksonville forced three turnovers and held Indianapolis to 243 yards, including a 92-yard pick-six by Rayuan Lane III.
take: Trevor Lawrence was efficient but low-volume because the game was a blowout. Jaguars D/ST and Bhayshul Tuten had big days. Next up is a Thursday night game at Baltimore, without Lamar Jackson.

affects: Parker Washington; Trevor Lawrence
subject: Parker Washington
headline: Parker Washington held to one catch for 16 yards in blowout win
body: Washington caught 1 of 2 targets for 16 yards and ran once for 10 yards. Lawrence attempted only 14 passes and Quinn Ewers three in mop-up duty. Washington has 27 catches for 432 yards and four touchdowns on 48 targets this season.
take: A quiet game for Parker Washington due to game script, not role. He stays a flex option for Thursday night at Baltimore in Week 9.

affects: Bucky Irving; Chase McLaughlin; Emeka Egbuka
subject: Bucky Irving
headline: Bucky Irving runs for a career-high 170 yards and a TD as Bucs blank Falcons 16-0 in the rain
body: Irving carried 27 times for 170 yards and a touchdown, and Kenneth Gainwell added 25 carries for 140 yards as Tampa Bay set a franchise record with 322 rushing yards. Baker Mayfield went 0 for 3. The Bucs kicker made all three field goals (46, 34 and 42 yards).
take: Bucky Irving is locked in as an RB1 with heavy volume. Kenneth Gainwell's 140 yards make him one of the best handcuffs on waivers. Chase McLaughlin made all three of his kicks in a game with few touchdowns.

affects: Vikings D/ST; Jordan Mason; Aaron Jones Sr.; Justin Jefferson; T.J. Hockenson; Will Reichard; Jahmyr Gibbs; Jared Goff; Jake Bates; Amon-Ra St. Brown; Jameson Williams; Sam LaPorta
subject: Vikings D/ST
headline: Lions edge Vikings 19-15 in Detroit
body: Detroit won 19-15 to move to 5-2, handing Minnesota its first loss (6-1). NFL.com had not yet posted game details.
take: A low-scoring game: Vikings D/ST held Detroit to 19 points, a solid floor game, while the Lions and Vikings skill players had limited scoring chances.

affects: Braelon Allen; Breece Hall
subject: Breece Hall
headline: Breece Hall (quad) inactive vs. Raiders; Braelon Allen confirmed as Jets lead back
body: The Jets listed Breece Hall among their inactives for the 1:00 p.m. ET game against Las Vegas, along with EDGE David Bailey and WR Tim Patrick. Braelon Allen starts again.
take: The earlier report held up. Braelon Allen stays in Dennis's lineup as the Jets' lead back. No lineup change needed.

affects: Josh Allen; James Cook III
subject: Josh Palmer
headline: Bills WR Josh Palmer (hamstring) doubtful to return vs. Ravens
body: Palmer injured his hamstring during Buffalo's game against Baltimore and is listed as doubtful to return.
take: Losing Palmer thins Buffalo's receiver group for the rest of the game. Josh Allen leans more on his remaining targets, and James Cook III could see a few more looks out of the backfield.

affects: RJ Harvey
subject: RJ Harvey
headline: Broncos place RJ Harvey (knee) on injured reserve; Cody Schrader elevated
body: After ruling RJ Harvey out for Sunday against the Chiefs with a knee injury, Denver placed him on injured reserve Saturday and elevated RB Cody Schrader from the practice squad. Jonah Coleman is next in line.
take: RJ Harvey is out for at least four games on IR, so Gevers can leave him in an IR slot. He is a bench stash only until he returns.

affects: Brock Bowers
subject: Jack Bech
headline: Raiders activate WR Jack Bech (forearm) from IR ahead of the Jets game
body: NFL Network's Ian Rapoport reported the Raiders would activate Jack Bech from injured reserve for Week 8, and the move was made Saturday.
take: Bech adds another target for the Raiders, but Brock Bowers stays the focal point and remains a locked-in TE start for Carlier.

affects: Josh Jacobs
subject: Josh Jacobs
headline: NFL to review additional allegations involving Josh Jacobs
body: Tom Pelissero reports the NFL will review additional allegations; Adam Schefter added that other women contacted police during the investigation. Jacobs' attorneys called the claims uncorroborated. No change to his playing status has been announced.
take: Josh Jacobs already played Thursday, but further league discipline is possible. Carlier should keep MarShawn Lloyd in mind as the handcuff.

affects: A.J. Brown
subject: A.J. Brown & TreVeyon Henderson
headline: Patriots rule out A.J. Brown (knee/ankle) and TreVeyon Henderson (illness) at Miami
body: New England downgraded both players to out on Saturday. Brown's knee flared up and he could not finish Wednesday's practice; Henderson missed Thursday and Friday with an illness. Rhamondre Stevenson leads the backfield, and Kyle Williams, DeMario Douglas and Efton Chism III are the healthy receivers. On Saturday the Patriots signed RB Lan Larison to the 53-man roster and elevated WR Ryan Miller.
take: A.J. Brown is in Wesley's RB/WR slot and scores zero if he stays there: swap him for Parker Washington, Ladd McConkey or Keaton Mitchell before the 10:25 PM kickoff. Henderson is already on the bench.

affects: Seth McGowan; Jordan Mason; Jadarian Price; Josh Jacobs; RJ Harvey
subject: Jonathan Taylor
headline: Taylor trade talks heat up: Colts already rejected a second-round-plus offer; he plays Sunday
body: Adam Schefter and Ian Rapoport report Indianapolis is open to dealing Taylor before the Nov. 10 deadline, with the Broncos, Packers, Vikings, Giants and Seahawks showing interest. ESPN says the Colts have received at least one offer that includes a second-round pick, and Tom Pelissero says it was immediately rejected. The Athletic's James Boyd says the Colts are not shopping Taylor but are listening. Shane Steichen said Taylor is set to play Sunday at Jacksonville.
take: Seth McGowan stays a handcuff for Sunday, but a trade would make him the Colts' lead back, so keep him. A move to Minnesota would hurt Jordan Mason, to Seattle would hurt Jadarian Price, to Green Bay would cut into Josh Jacobs' role, and to Denver would squeeze RJ Harvey.

affects: Brian Thomas Jr.; Parker Washington; Trevor Lawrence; Brenton Strange
subject: Brian Thomas Jr.
headline: Pelissero: Jaguars continue to get trade interest in Brian Thomas Jr.
body: Tom Pelissero reports Jacksonville keeps receiving trade calls on Brian Thomas Jr., with any deal likely closer to the Nov. 10 deadline. Thomas sits behind Parker Washington and Jakobi Meyers on the depth chart and has 9 catches for 105 yards in six games.
take: A trade could revive Brian Thomas Jr. elsewhere for Gevers. In Jacksonville his exit would firm up Parker Washington and Brenton Strange as Trevor Lawrence's main targets.

affects: Kyle Monangai; Caleb Williams; Seahawks D/ST
subject: Kyle Monangai
headline: Ben Johnson rules Kyle Monangai (turf toe, thumb) out for Monday night
body: Monangai has not practiced since the turf toe injury and will miss a fourth straight game, but he was not placed on IR. D'Andre Swift leads Chicago's backfield. TE Cole Kmet is already out and TE Colston Loveland (neck) was added to Friday's report as limited.
take: Kyle Monangai stays on the bench. Caleb Williams is down a running back and possibly a tight end, which helps the Seahawks D/ST on Monday night.

affects: Keenan Allen; Alec Pierce; Germie Bernard
subject: Josh Downs
headline: Colts fielding calls on WR Josh Downs; Steelers among interested teams
body: Tom Pelissero reports the Colts got trade calls for Josh Downs before he requested a trade. Jordan Schultz says the Steelers are one of several AFC teams interested and the expectation is Downs is traded before Nov. 10.
take: A Downs trade would open targets for Keenan Allen (and Alec Pierce once healthy). If he lands in Pittsburgh, he would compete with Germie Bernard for looks from Aaron Rodgers.

affects: Caleb Williams; Luther Burden III; Jaxon Smith-Njigba; Seahawks D/ST; Jadarian Price
subject: Bears at Seahawks
headline: Bears-Seahawks preview: Caleb Williams QB10, Burden WR18, JSN leads the league in fantasy points
body: Fantasy Life ranks Caleb Williams QB10; he is QB4 in points per game (20.9) with 32 rushing yards per game. Luther Burden III is a WR18 start, and he and Rome Odunze have drawn over a third of Chicago's targets recently. Jaxon Smith-Njigba leads the NFL in fantasy points with a 36.3% target share. Seattle's defense leads the league in efficiency with a top-3 pressure rate. Seattle is a 3-point favorite with a 46.5 total. Charbonnet and Price are both returning from injury.
take: Start Caleb Williams, Luther Burden III and Jaxon Smith-Njigba for Wesley. The Seahawks D/ST is a solid start for Gevers, though Williams' mobility limits the sack upside. Even if Price is activated, he will likely share snaps with Charbonnet.

affects: Omar Cooper Jr.
subject: Omar Cooper Jr.
headline: Rookie Cooper has 100+ yards and a TD in both games since coming off IR
body: Since returning in Week 6, Cooper has gone 6-103-1 against New England and 5-115-1 against Miami. He plays about two-thirds of his snaps in the slot and ranks near the top of the league in yards after the catch. This week he faces Raiders nickel Taron Johnson.
take: He scored 22.5 on your bench last week. His 10.5 projection looks low for his current form, so he's worth a look at RB/WR flex.

affects: Tetairoa McMillan
subject: Tetairoa McMillan
headline: McMillan leads Panthers with 6-57 on 11 targets in TNF loss at Green Bay
body: He was the team's top receiver in the 27-19 loss but finished under 60 yards for the second straight game. He has six or more catches in three of his last four games. Next up: Denver at home on Nov. 8.
take: His 11.8 points are already locked in for Week 8. The volume keeps his floor safe despite Bryce Young's struggles, but the Broncos defense is a tough draw next week.

affects: Dallas Goedert
subject: Dallas Goedert
headline: Eagles expected to field trade offers on Dallas Goedert
body: Fox Sports' Ralph Vacchiano reports the 2-5 Eagles are expected to listen to offers on Goedert, G Landon Dickerson and CB Riq Woolen. Goedert, 31, is back to full strength on a one-year deal with void years, so a trade would bring about $28 million in dead money.
take: Nothing changes for Sunday night, where Goedert is a locked-in start. A deadline trade could move him to a new offense before Nov. 10, so watch his role after this week.

affects: Ollie Gordon II
subject: Ollie Gordon II
headline: Ollie Gordon: 25-103-1 vs. Jets, a touchdown in four straight games
body: Since De'Von Achane's season-ending ACL tear, Gordon has 69 carries for 332 yards and 4 TDs and is Miami's clear lead back. Backup Jaylen Wright left the Jets game with a quad injury. New England is a 7.5-point favorite in Miami.
take: Start Ollie Gordon II in Gevers' RB/WR slot. His workload is secure, though a negative game script could limit his carries late.

affects: Deebo Samuel Sr.; Mike Evans
subject: Deebo Samuel Sr.
headline: Deebo Samuel (hamstring) eyeing a Week 9 return after 49ers bye
body: Samuel has missed two games with the hamstring injury. A Week 9 return "isn't promised" but fits the usual recovery timeline. Mike Evans has been the 49ers' leading receiver while playing through rib and Achilles issues.
take: Nothing to do this week because San Francisco is on bye. Watch next week's practice reports before moving him off IR. Mike Evans is also on bye, so leave him on the bench this week.
